ambient_events: Navigation glass paints the Basin in cold vector lines across the forward window.
The helm console breathes a slow blue pulse, waiting for a hand.
Far below the bow, the water parts around nothing, patient.
description: The bridge. A single curved window of smoked glass wraps the bow, the Basin beyond rendered in cold navigational overlays. The helm console sits at the center: a slab of dark glass and one worn brass throttle, the only analogue thing aboard. From here the Echelon is steered, one deliberate move at a time. The foyer lies to the SOUTH.
name: Echelon — Bridge
